target_customer: Site owners needing industrial inspection, mapping and security patrols (company site); robot makers needing real-world trials (YC listing)
problem: Inspection and security tasks have labor shortages due to safety risks, and robots need real-world deployment data.
business_model: Managed robot service with pilots and site surveys (pricing not public)
product_category: Robot deployment and inspection service with quadruped robots

founders.name: Adith Reddi
founders.background_notes: Music producer with 1M+ streams per the YC page.

founders.name: Kenny Zhang
founders.background_notes: Music producer who releases on Spotify per the YC page.

competitors.name: Prosegur with Boston Dynamics Spot
competitors.what: Spot quadrupeds fitted with sensing payloads for guard patrols

competitors.name: Asylon
competitors.what: DroneDog managed security patrol service on Spot
competitors.traction_then: Sold to industrial sites and data centers
competitors.funding_then: Series B reported at $24M or $26M depending on source (date not confirmed)

technical_complexity.rationale: Deploying off-the-shelf quadrupeds with LiDAR mapping and patrol routing is integration work; training their own policies would be much harder.

defensibility.rationale: Hardware comes from third parties and several managed patrol services already existed; any edge would come from deployment data.

market_need_then: The company cites labor shortages in inspection and security; a trade article describes data center customers seeking quadrupeds for inspection and mapping (dated 2026).

branding.name_origin: Evokes the physical Turing test concept discussed by NVIDIA's Jim Fan; no source states the founders chose it for that reason.

rebrands.why: The founders moved from a music production tool to robotics; their stated reason was not found

brand_strength.rationale: No coverage of the brand itself was found, and searches for the name mostly return the unrelated Physical Turing Test concept.

pivots.from: Riff, an AI music production tool by the same founders
pivots.why: Not stated in the sources found

outcome_analysis: Physical Turing was started by two Berkeley CS founders who previously built an AI music tool called Riff, and joined YC in Summer 2025. They offer quadruped inspection and patrol service while existing managed patrol vendors are established. No funding, customers or exit were found, so the outcome is unknown.
notes: Descriptions conflict: the YC listing summary mentions evaluating humanoids in the real world, while the company site describes quadruped inspection and security. Pivot date from Riff is not sourced beyond the YC page listing the earlier launch. Competitor entries are from sources that are undated or from 2022 and 2026 coverage. No funding found anywhere.
